CheckTitle: Check if S3 buckets have object versioning enabled
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks that object versioning is enabled on S3 buckets.
Risk: Without versioning, accidental or malicious overwrites and deletions (including ransomware) are unrecoverable.

Recommendation.Text: Enable versioning (and optionally MFA Delete and lifecycle rules for non-current versions).

Notes: CIS AWS 3.0 2.1.2 (MFA Delete) requires versioning; mapped there as the nearest control.
